716666001.speakerName: Count Crushmore's Companion God of Cookery
716666001.text: Hey! Good to see everyone! How's it going? Having fun?

716666002.text: Xiangling, Guoba! You finally made it! Well, Bull-Chuc{RUBY#[S]"Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King"}ker's certainly having a blast.

716666004.text: Guoba-san! I've been training hard at the Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp, and now I wanna show you just how far I've come! ...Uh, and Crimson Staff too!

716666005.text: If my progress satisfies you, then please, teach me! Show me the way to communicate with Crimson Staff, Crystal Tornado, and all the shelled organisms of this world!

716666006.text: Do that, and I swear, once I become the reigning champion of the beetle-fighting world, I will build a mighty statue in your image at the Arataki Gang's beetle-fighting headquarters!

716666008.text: What the...! Guoba-san got a brand new Onikabuto?

716666010.text: It appears to be not a typical Onikabuto shell, but one built of resilient wood... Is it wearing a suit of armor?

716666011.text: We told Granny all about your Onikabuto boot camp. It really piqued her interest when she heard that Guoba was getting a disciple...

716666012.text: As it turned out, a friend of hers had made her a whole bunch of gardening and landscaping machines to look after the Silk Flowers on the terrace. They're called Bloom Pruners.

716666013.speakerName: Count Crushmore's Companion God of Cookery
716666013.text: The Bloom Pruner can transform into the shape of any creature to blend into its environment. Squirrels, Butterflies, Finches, you name it. And of course, Onikabuto too.

716666014.speakerName: Count Crushmore's Companion God of Cookery
716666014.text: So Master gave Guoba a Bloom Pruner and got it to take the form of an Onikabuto so it can battle against you.

716666015.text: ...That's pretty hi-tech for a gardening appliance.

716666016.text: Xiangling's master is Madame Ping, so Madame Ping's friend... Aha! Of course!

716666019.text: No machine can compare to a real, live Onikabuto warrior! Did Guoba-san pick a dumbed-down enemy on purpose so we can showcase all our awesome skills?

716666020.text: You may be wise to temper your optimism, Oni King... My beetle senses are failing to detect this Onikabuto's might. Or perhaps... it's too profound for me to fathom.

716666021.text: Eh, it's not even alive. There's nothing for you to sense.

716666022.text: Uhh anyway, Guoba-san may possess limitless power, but a warrior needs to be one with his weapon. The bond between Onikabuto and trainer is forged through blood, sweat, and tears, not wood, mesh, and gears! Crimson Staff and I are like glove and fist.

716666023.text: Let's get this duel going. It's time for Guoba-san to witness my true potential once and for all!

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Arataki Itto and company

715280101.text: Whoa! Bull-Chu{RUBY#[S]"Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King"}cker sure made short work of the Bloom Pruner!

715280102.text: I won! Victory is mine! With my trusty Crimson Staff, I have defeated the mighty Guoba{RUBY#[S]"Calamitous Colossus Count Crushmore"}-san!

715280103.text: Alrighty then... Hoo-hoo, the moment I've been waiting for!

715280104.text: Ahem... Guoba-san, if I have earned your recognition, I humbly ask you to teach me the ways of shelled-organism communication...

715280106.text: ...Huh? Guoba-san, you look... pleased? But you just lost to me in battle...

715280107.text: Does this mean you're... proud of me for my swift progress?

715280108.text: Aw, shucks, I dunno what to say! Hahahahaha, you're too kind, Guoba-san! ...Ah, you're just being modest, I know you were going easy on me...

715280109.text: It looks like Guoba's all warmed up now. The Bloom Pruner is ready to operate at full power.

715280110.text: Guoba, remember the plan? In this round, we wanna increase the Bloom Pruner's power output from a tenth of a percent to one percent, okay?

715280111.text: Any higher, and you'll risk knocking Itto's Onikabuto out cold.

715280113.text: Okay, there it is. Paimon knew something was up.

715280116.text: As I feared... We've barely scratched the surface...

715280118.text: A tenth of one percent? As in... zero-point-one percent? As in... one one-thousandth!?

715280119.text: You've got... You've gotta be kidding me! All that... was just one ONE-THOUSANDTH of its top power?

715280121.text: Guoba's a little confused. You did say you wanted to train your Onikabuto to defeat Crystal Tornado, correct?

715280122.text: I thought it would go without saying given the size... The Bloom Pruner has to shift rocks the size of casserole dishes, so obviously it has to be pretty strong.

715280123.text: Even then, Crystal Tornado is bigger still... It dwarfs me and Guoba, and it's even taller than you!

715280124.text: That's impossible... If we were talking twice as strong as the last fight, I think I'd have a shot. Ten times as strong, and we're already looking at losing most, if not all, of the time...

715280125.text: But a thousand times stronger? Who am I kidding... It's hopeless!

715280127.text: "When your tactics fail, you have to change your point of view. In our journeys far and wide, we often have to think on our feet!"

715280128.text: "Clinging to old methods can never solve the problem, no matter how hard you try!"

715280129.text: ...Of course, Guoba-san! This is what you've been trying to tell me all along!

715280130.text: I gotta study mechanics! Then build a suit of armor for Crimson Staff that'll take his abilities to a whole new level!

715280131.text: Or maybe... Heck, I could build a bigger, stronger, mechanical Onikabuto! Piloted by Crimson Staff under my direction!

715280133.text: An Onikabuto piloting a mechanical Onikabuto? How do you expect to pull that off? And does that even still count as a beetle battle?
